dedupe_keys.name: gis data package for offshore nw ireland including mcda tool for floating wind farm site selection

description: Jason McFadden and Andrew Wheeler publish GIS inputs and outputs from a multi-objective floating-wind siting study off northwest Ireland. Zenodo provides a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Its metadata lists raw and derived datasets, ArcGIS Pro map packages, and internal readme and walkthrough documents for layers and constraint mapping. The package can support offshore-energy site screening and comparison of resource, environmental or infrastructure constraints. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this regional GIS package. A limitation is that the public page does not enumerate the full layer list, coordinate systems, spatial resolution or decision weights. Those details are said to be inside the archive, which was not downloaded under this review’s metadata-only rule. The deposited output represents one project’s assumptions, not a verified permission to build a wind farm. No MCDA calculation was repeated.
